fixed_recipe: tree-regularized consensus + 0.1025 personalized slate-token frequency - 0.165 repeated-video indicator + 0.145 slate-author frequency
selection_evidence: All three sequential corrections improved cross-fitted primary on disjoint user folds. Fixed weights are the means of the two fold-selected weights.
leakage_note: The correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. It never reads long_view, click, watch time, or another validation outcome. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use this correction as written.
rejected_ablations: Monte Carlo dropout LCB: fold correction signs disagreed and OOF primary regressed.
Continuous watch-ratio margin: widened cross-fitted primary regressed to 0.61106056.
Synthetic-exposure density weighting: square-root OOF primary was 0.611053 and full weighting was 0.6109525.
Video-type slate concentration: fixed score improved but cross-fitted primary regressed, so it was excluded.
